response.overview: Elster awakens in an empty field, drawn towards a mysterious copy of The King in Yellow and the promise of returning home. In a red room, she finds Ariane, her dying lover, who asks her to fulfil her promise and end her life. Unable to bear the thought of losing her, Elster retreats into memories of their time together, reliving moments of tenderness and happiness beneath a setting sun. But as unsettling echoes interrupt these memories, the boundary between past and present begins to blur. Torn between her love for Ariane and the promise she must keep, Elster faces an impossible choice: to hold on to the woman she loves, or finally let her go.
response.tagline: The cruelest thing about love is having to let go.
response.title: SIGNALIS
